info.title: API.SH: npm
info.description: The npm API from API.SH: public npm data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Known security advisories for a package: id, title, severity, vulnerable version range, link, CWE ids and CVSS score and vector, with a count by severity. Checks the versions given, or every published version.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/npm-audit

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Package name (lodash or lodash@4.17.20).

parameters.name: versions
parameters.description: Comma-separated versions to check (default: every version).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

parameters.name: name

parameters.name: page

get.description:
Download totals for a package over a period (last-day, last-week, last-month, last-year, or a YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD range up to 18 months), with the per-day series, daily average and peak day. Optionally add last-week downloads per version.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/npm-downloads

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Package name (scoped names like @types/node work), or an npmjs.com URL.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: last-day, last-week (default), last-month, last-year or YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: by_version
parameters.description: true to include last-week downloads per version.

parameters.name: versions_limit
parameters.description: Versions returned with by_version, 1-1000 (default 100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One npm package: latest version, description, license, repository, homepage, keywords, maintainers, dist-tags, last publish time and publisher, dependencies (regular, peer, optional), engines, unpacked size and file count, dependents count, weekly downloads for the last year, daily downloads for the last month, every version with its publish date and last-week downloads (newest first) and the README as HTML. `vulnerabilities=true` adds `vulnerabilities`: the published security advisories affecting the latest version (id, title, severity, vulnerable version range, CWE ids, CVSS score and vector, advisory URL); an empty list means none are known, null means the lookup could not be completed.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/npm-package

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Package name, scoped names included (@types/node), or an npmjs.com package URL.

parameters.name: versions_limit
parameters.description: How many versions to list, newest first (default 100).

parameters.name: vulnerabilities
parameters.description: true adds the security advisories affecting the latest version (default false).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search the npm registry: name, version, description, keywords, publisher, maintainers, links, weekly and monthly downloads, dependents and score. npm search qualifiers (keywords:, author:, maintainer:, scope:) work in q. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/npm-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1-250 (default 20).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every published version of a package, newest first: publish time, dist-tags pointing at it, deprecation flag, provenance, and link. Filter by prerelease, deprecated or dist-tag. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/npm-versions

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Package name (scoped names like @types/node work), or an npmjs.com URL.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Versions per page, 1-500 (default 50).

parameters.name: prerelease
parameters.description: false to hide prerelease versions (default true).

parameters.name: deprecated
parameters.description: true to list only deprecated versions.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only the version a dist-tag points at, e.g. latest.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
